name: Barcelona
summary: Gaudí's city by the sea, and a base for day trips to Montserrat's mountain monastery, medieval Girona and Dalí's museum in Figueres.

tips.title: 90 days in any 180
tips.body: Visa-free visitors can stay in the Schengen area, which includes Spain, for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Earlier Schengen visits in those 180 days count, and overstaying can bring a ban of up to 3 years.

tips.title: Check your passport dates
tips.body: Your passport must be issued less than 10 years before you arrive and expire at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.

tips.title: Fingerprints at the border (EES)
tips.body: The EU Entry/Exit System replaces passport stamps. On your first visit you may register fingerprints and a photo at a booth before passport control. It's free, and the record lasts 3 years.

tips.title: ETIAS isn't running yet
tips.body: ETIAS, the EU's online travel authorisation for visa-free visitors, was not yet operational in August 2026 and was expected to launch in late 2026. It is not a visa. Check before you fly.

tips.title: Have proof ready at the border
tips.body: Border officers may ask to see a return or onward ticket, travel insurance, enough money for your stay and where you are staying.

tips.title: Watch for pickpockets
tips.body: Be alert to street crime. Thieves use distraction techniques and often work in teams. Don't leave your passport at hotel reception to collect later.

tips.title: Carry photo ID
tips.body: You must show photo ID if a police officer asks.

tips.title: Keep your drink in sight
tips.body: Buy your own drinks and keep them in sight so they can't be spiked.

tips.title: Emergency number 112
tips.body: Call 112 for police, ambulance or fire.

tips.title: Get travel insurance
tips.body: UK and EU visitors can use a GHIC or EHIC for state healthcare, but it is not a replacement for travel insurance.

tips.title: Summer heat and wildfires
tips.body: Extreme heat hits much of Spain in summer. Starting a wildfire is a crime even by accident, so take care with cigarettes and barbecues.

tips.title: Declare €10,000 or more in cash
tips.body: Cash of €10,000 or more must be declared when you enter or leave the EU. Use official exchange offices or banks to change money.

tips.title: No meat or dairy in your bag
tips.body: You can't bring meat, milk or products containing them into the EU from outside it, with a few exceptions.

tips.title: Barcelona tourist tax up to €12 a night
tips.body: Since 1 April 2026 Barcelona adds a €5 city surcharge to the Catalan tax. Totals per person per night: €12 in 5-star hotels, €8.40 in 4-star, €9.50 in tourist apartments, €6 in hostels. Children 16 and under are exempt.

places.name: Plaça d'Espanya station
places.blurb: FGC station for R5 trains to Montserrat.

places.name: Montserrat rack railway
places.blurb: Cremallera rack railway up the mountain to the monastery.

places.name: Montserrat Monastery and Basilica
places.blurb: Benedictine abbey of Santa Maria de Montserrat on a jagged mountain, home of the Black Madonna.

places.name: Escolania de Montserrat
places.blurb: One of Europe's oldest boys' choirs, singing in the basilica.

places.name: Sant Jeroni peak
places.blurb: Montserrat's highest point at 1,236 m, a hike from the monastery.

places.name: Sant Joan funicular
places.blurb: Funicular from the monastery up to the Sant Joan trails, a shortcut toward Sant Jeroni.

places.name: Barcelona-Sants station
places.blurb: Main station for AVE high-speed trains to Girona and Figueres.

places.name: Girona Cathedral
places.blurb: Cathedral at the top of a grand stairway, with one of the widest Gothic naves in the world.

places.name: Arab Baths
places.blurb: Romanesque bathhouse from the 12th century in the old town.

places.name: Jewish Quarter (El Call)
places.blurb: Narrow medieval lanes of one of Europe's best-kept Jewish quarters.

places.name: Houses on the Onyar
places.blurb: Row of colourful houses along the River Onyar; Girona doubled as Braavos and King's Landing in Game of Thrones.

places.name: El Celler de Can Roca
places.blurb: Three-Michelin-star Catalan restaurant run by the Roca brothers.

places.name: Dalí Theatre-Museum
places.blurb: Dalí's own museum, with giant eggs on the roof and the artist buried in a crypt below the stage.
places.tip: Oct to Dec and Jan to mid-Mar: Tuesday to Sunday, 10:30 am to 6 pm. Jul and Aug: daily, 9 am to 8 pm.
